_comment: The gateway's own default agent -- the one an inbound Signal message lands
on. NOT an agent anybody authored and NOT listed in the builder: it is the
gateway's reception desk, and this file exists for one reason -- to keep
its tool surface narrow. Measured 2026-09-01: an MCP server is registered
GLOBALLY, and an agent WITHOUT an explicit allow list receives every tool
the gateway has, including every MCP tool registered later. Until this
list existed, main carried all of them, exec included, sandbox off,
reachable by anyone who knew the number.
The rollout renders this entry into agents.list beside the real agents
(the list is replaced whole, so it has to be here). Its workspace is the
shared, hand-made one and is never touched by the rollout.
Who may write to the channel at all is a question left open on purpose
(ADR-029): the same question stands at three doors, and answering it here
alone would answer it a third.

_measured: Dormant: two sessions in three months, and the only tools it ever called
were memory_search and cron. mora02 itself never runs a turn on it --
notify uses `message send`, a CLI call with no model in it.
